text:
jordan: Postmortem PM-238 follow-up: two repeat patterns — brief eviction spikes that degrade tail latency, and transient 500 storms during overlapping rollouts. We need concise runbook edits, clear owners, and a skim-friendly escalation flow.

kate: Agree. The playbook is too long to use in-the-moment. Propose a 2-line fast-path and an 1-paragraph checklist.

sam: I'll own the eviction remediation: collect traces, map back to model variants, and propose mitigations (e.g., conservative autoscaler, prefix cache tweaks). ETA: Wed EOD.

leo: I'll author the fast-path cuecard and paste exact triage commands. Keep it <=6 lines.

maria: Proposed escalation order: 1) on-call pager -> 2) runtime eng -> 3) infra -> 4) exec if P0 > 30m. I'll update the flow diagram and include rotation links.

jordan: Add the exec escalation condition and link to rotations. Keep wording minimal for scans.

leo: Cuecard draft (for insertion):
`1) Check metrics: inference.tokens/sec, runtime.queue_depth, runtime.evictions.count`
`2) Pod quickcheck: kubectl get pods -l app=runtime -n inference -o wide`
`3) If evictions spike: curl -s http://localhost:8080/debug/evictions; journalctl -u runtime -n 200`
`4) If 5xx spike during rollout: rollback to previous variant; scale to stable replica count`
`5) If latency > SLO >5m: enable traffic-shed (/infra traffic-shed on) and escalate`

kate: Add autoscaler toggle: `/infra autoscale set conservative` and the alert name to silence when rolling back.

sam: Actions: [sam] PM-238-REM-1: remediation doc + logs/repro (due Wed EOD). [leo] cuecard + commands (due Tue). [maria] escalation diagram + rotation links (due Fri). [kate] autoscale/traffic-shed checklist + alert names (due Tue).

incident-bot: Created ticket PM-238-REM-1 assigned to sam, due 2026-03-25.

jordan: I'll check Friday; schedule 30-min sync if blockers. If anyone finishes early, post short note here.

maria: I'll also draft a detection rule for the eviction pattern (alert group inference.eviction-patterns): >3 eviction spikes across pods within 10m AND sustained queue_depth > threshold.

sam: I'll attach required logs and repro steps to the ticket so on-call can act immediately.

leo: After edits, I'll ping for a quick review. Plan: top-level fast-path + full deep-dive preserved.

kate: :thumbsup: small, focused edits should speed up incident handling.

jordan: Thanks all. Closing this thread, will reopen if anything slips.
